correctness.rationale: For two autonomous environmental states, direct stationary flux balance gives a fractional-linear occupancy whose derivative is ab*s1*s2*(s1-s2)*(theta1-theta2)/((a+b)*[s1*s2+q*(b*s1+a*s2)]^2); the sign is independent of q. For symmetric complete n-state environment, exact joint balance gives P=(sum c_i/(s_i+nq))/(sum s_i/(s_i+nq)); substituting c=(1,7,7), e=(1,1,7) gives P=5/8+9q/[8(9q^2+39q+28)] with derivative sign(28-9q^2), unique global maximum q=2sqrt(7)/3 and exact value (27-sqrt(7))/38. Positive finite rates ensure uniqueness. The standalone verify.py independently solves 319 exact rational joint CTMC stationary systems and checks symbolic equalities; finite checks supplement, not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The contrast between monotonic stationary occupancy under every two-state Markov environmental switcher and a unique interior optimum under the smallest possible three-state environment establishes an exact structural threshold in ecological fluctuation-frequency response. The three-state witness has identical slow and fast stationary limits but a strict improvement at each finite speed, proving that endpoint comparisons can conceal a meaningful optimal switching rate. The claim is not a routine table lookup or only a numerical curiosity; it gives a full all-positive-parameter impossibility and an exact sharp attainable boundary with clear ecological interpretation. It does not claim downstream nonlinear ecosystem management predictions.
